description: Work the To-dos inside a Project (Workspace → Project → To-do). Use this, not mind_tasks, for to-dos that belong to a project and may be shown to a client in the Astra AI portal. Create with project_id + title; move them with start/complete/reopen; put one on the calendar with schedule (unschedule removes it). Each to-do has a thread: comment adds a note, ask posts a question that needs the client's/owner's answer, decide posts a decision with options, reply answers a question or decision (pass comment_id; resolution/choice marks it resolved), thread reads it all. waiting lists to-dos blocked on a reply, progress gives a project's rollup, search finds to-dos by text in title/notes/comments. An empty list means none match the filter.

action.description: list/search/get/create/update/delete to-dos; start/complete/reopen change state; schedule/unschedule put it on the calendar; comment/ask/decide/reply/thread work the to-do thread; progress (project rollup) and waiting (to-dos waiting on a reply)

assignee.description: Filter list by assignee (username, agent slug or email)

assignee_id.description: On create/update: username, agent slug, or email

assignee_type.description: On create/update: user, agent, external, unassigned

choice.description: reply: the chosen option for a decision

comment_id.description: reply: id of the question/decision comment being answered

due_before.description: List only to-dos due before this date YYYY-MM-DD

external_ref.description: Link to an outside system, e.g. {system:'astra_portal', id:'...'}

priority.description: Priority: none, low, medium, high, urgent

project_id.description: Project id — required for create and progress; filters list

q.description: Search text (required for search; also filters list)

resolution.description: reply: resolution text; marks the question resolved

spec.description: Free-form spec object stored on the to-do

status.description: Filter (list) or new status: open, in_progress, blocked, done

waiting.description: List only to-dos waiting on a reply

name: mind_todos
